description: Trigger discrimination for the MANUAL-ONLY setup conversation (this skill) vs whole-journey navigation (project-orchestrator). Cases where no specific winner is asserted live in evals.json as should_not_trigger cases.

cases.prompt: Explicitly invoke aegis-setup. Help me set up Aegis
cases.reason: On a host that treats the explicit setup phrase as a deliberate manual invocation (SKILL.md Use When), it routes here and is not lifecycle navigation; the host that cannot establish that invocation is modeled by evals.json phrase-without-invocation.

cases.prompt: Explicitly invoke aegis-setup. Help me change my Aegis setup
cases.reason: The explicit change phrase is the deliberate manual invocation for reviewing or changing the saved setup; it is not lifecycle navigation.

cases.prompt: I want to build a SaaS app; where do I start?
cases.reason: A vague product idea needs lifecycle navigation, which project-orchestrator owns; it is not a setup invocation.

cases.prompt: Use the project-orchestrator skill to guide my next stage
cases.reason: A request explicitly naming another skill goes to that skill; the setup skill must not take it.
